format: Traditional Potbelly Shop, about 1,500 to 2,000 sq ft of leased space (strip center, mall, lifestyle center); real estate cost not estimated

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of each Potbelly Shop franchise is $628,938 to $999,371. This includes $38,000 to $144,000 that must be paid to the franchisor or affiliate.

fee.quote: You must pay us a $40,000 initial franchise fee in full when you sign the Franchise Agreement, although we may reduce the initial franchise fee if you qualify for our incentive program described below.
fee.note: 50/50 Incentive Program (SDAA developers, Shops opened early or on time in 2026-2027): fee reduced 50% to $20,000 and royalty reduced 50% for 1 to 52 weeks; the Item 7 low ($628,938) uses the $20,000 fee. LAD Incentive (15+ Shops): same 50% fee cut plus 50% royalty cut while open early and 50% lower development fee. SDAA development fee: $40,000 plus $20,000 deposit per additional Shop. Fees actually received in 2025: $10,000 to $40,000. No veteran discount printed.

royalty.quote: Royalty 6% of Shop’s weekly Total Revenue Due each Wednesday on Total Revenue during week ending on preceding Sunday

adFund.quote: Brand Fund Currently 3% of Shop’s weekly Total Revenue ... We may, upon 90 days’ prior notice to you, increase your Brand Fund contribution by up to an additional 1% of the Shop’s Total Revenue (for a total of up to 4% of the Shop’s Total Revenue)
adFund.note: Currently 3%, up to 4%. Minimum Local Marketing Spend 1% of Total Revenue; total required marketing capped at 5%. Market Introduction Program $10,000 to $15,000 at opening.

otherRecurring.name: Technology Services Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $1,165 per month plus $0.20 per digital transaction, plus any applicable taxes

otherRecurring.name: Product purchases from franchisor/affiliates (Potbelly Trade Secret and Branded Products)
otherRecurring.amount: Varies depending on products and services you buy from us or our affiliates

transferFee.amount: 20% or 50% of our then-current initial franchise fee depending on whether transferee is an existing Potbelly franchisee (Controlling Transfers); $500 for non-controlling or convenience-of-ownership transfers

item19.quote: 2025 All Shops ... Shop Count 97 ... Median Unit Volume 1,195,243 ... Average Unit Volume 1,344,085 # / % Shops above Avg 33 / 34% (Potbelly Franchise 2025 Average Unit Volume)
item19.note: Sales only: 'does not reflect the costs of sales, operating expenses, or other costs or expenses'. Excludes 24 franchised Shops not open the entire 12-period timeframe (22 opened, 2 closed). The franchised all-shop average includes 5 airport Shops averaging $3,430,686, which lifts it; suburban franchised average is $1,187,544. Although the intro mentions expenses and profits for affiliate Shops, only unit volumes are printed.

special: Franchisor or affiliate may sublease the premises; if rent is paid to the franchisor it 'may charge an amount that is higher than the rent due under the underlying lease' (not a % of sales). Required purchases from affiliate PSW, LLC (menu boards, lighting, millwork, decor: $18,000 to $42,000) and ongoing Potbelly Trade Secret Products. Temporary 50% royalty and fee reductions under the 50/50 and LAD incentive programs.
issues: Item 19 says 119 franchised Shops at December 28, 2025 vs 122 in Item 20 Table 1 (December 31). No cost or profit figures printed despite the Item 19 introduction. Transfer fee not printed in dollars (20% or 50% of $40,000 implies $8,000 or $20,000). Item 7 low uses the incentive $20,000 fee.
